Empty and singleton configurations imply covariance positive definiteness. Independently recomputed symbolic expansions confirm E2=0, E3=-2 lambda^5(1+3lambda), E4=2lambda^5 P4, E5=2lambda^6 P5, E6=2lambda^5 P6 with every listed coefficient correct. P4/P5 each have one positive root by Descartes and IVT; all P6 coefficients positive. Marginal matched covariance strictly negative for n>=3 by Bernoulli inequality, despite nonadjacent conditional independence. No claim n>=7. The package standard-library finite exhaustive tests were inspected but not used to infer all fugacities.
